five_tuple.research_question: 简单的视觉指令微调配方能否让开源多模态模型达到闭源水平？
five_tuple.methodology: 双视觉编码器(SigLIP+DINOv2)共享MLP连接器 + ASCII格式视觉指令数据
five_tuple.datasets: VQAv2/GQA/VisWiz, SQA, MMMU, MathVista, AI2D, BLINK 等 11 个基准
five_tuple.conclusions: LLaVA-1.5 在 11 个开源基准上刷新 SOTA，确立简单配方+好数据范式
five_tuple.limitations: 多图理解缺失、领域求解弱、幻觉未除、高分辨率训练成本高

evidence.quote: prolonged training for high-resolution images, lack of multiple-image understanding, limited problem solving capabilities in certain fields
It is not exempt from producing hallucinations, and should be used with caution in critical applications

five_tuple.research_question: 不训练模型，仅改变视觉工作表征（叠加编号标记），能否解锁 GPT-4V 的视觉定位能力？
five_tuple.methodology: Set-of-Mark：分割/检测器生成候选区域并叠加可读编号，文本提示引用编号
five_tuple.datasets: ReferCOCO/ReferIt3D, BLINK, SayCan, COCRECT 等（零样本评测）
five_tuple.conclusions: SoM 使 GPT-4V 零样本定位大幅超越微调 SOTA（SayCan 85.6）
five_tuple.limitations: 开源模型读不懂标记且机理未证；评测子集小；标注质量有上限

evidence.quote: both models can hardly interpret the mark
not grounded on the facts but on some empirical studies
only a small subset of each validation split was used
The “golden” annotations are not always golden

five_tuple.research_question: 如何在剔除文本捷径后鲁棒地度量专家级多模态推理？
five_tuple.methodology: 图像依赖选项过滤 + 10选1/开放作答改造 MMMU
five_tuple.datasets: MMMU-Pro (standard / vision), 扩展学科样本
five_tuple.conclusions: 改造后基准排名显著重排，开源与闭源差距被真实放大
five_tuple.limitations: MC10 转换引入新偏置；CoT 收益因模型/学科而反号；OCR 强不等于推理强

evidence.quote: CoT generally improved performance but benefits varied significantly
high OCR accuracy does not translate into strong multimodal reasoning
evidence.section: Does OCR help in the vision setting?

evidence.quote: Random choice drops from 22.1 (MMMU val) to 12.8/12.4
the benchmark is not merely harder but differently ordered

five_tuple.research_question: 把显式视觉定位信息写入思维链，能否提升 MLLM 的视觉推理？
five_tuple.methodology: Visual-CoT：程序辅助/工具增强/端到端三实现，坐标进思维链
five_tuple.datasets: 自构建 438k Visual CoT 数据集（含中间 bbox 标注）；MMVP/BLINK/MMMU 评测
five_tuple.conclusions: 显式视觉思维链在多数基准上提升多模态推理
five_tuple.limitations: 定位精度是主瓶颈；收益随规模变化；图表域不升反降

evidence.quote: it remains uncharted whether MLLMs can benefit from CoT inside the *visual understanding* process
annotated with intermediate bounding boxes highlighting key regions essential for answering the questions
